inlines.v: SOAR, verb intransitive 1. To fly aloft; to mount upon the wing; as an eagle. Hence, 2. To rise high; to mount; to tower in thought or imagination; to be sublime; as the poet or orator. 3. To rise high in ambition or heroism. Valor soars above what the world calls misfortune. 4. In general, to rise aloft; to be lofty. SOAR, noun A towering flight.
